9mar1568.summary: Forbes's copy of the three ciphered items of Norreys's letter: the French King, an unread five-sign word, and probably the Queen of Scots. In context (CSP Foreign viii no. 2054) Norreys reports that after the treaty of Longjumeau the King sent gentlemen to the Pope, the Emperor, the King Catholic and the Swiss, and that if peace is concluded an attempt will be made into Scotland for the delivery of the Queen.

siblings1567-68.summary: The ciphered words of Norreys's letters of 4 June, 6 July and 10 July 1567 and 6, 9 and 24 Feb 1567/8, as copied by Forbes, decrypted group by group with Tomokiyo's 1568 Cecil-Norris table and checked against the calendared letters in CSP Foreign viii.

snip.cap: Add MS 4136 f. 161: Forbes’s numbered copy of Norreys’s ciphered words, 6 February to 9 March 1567/8

system: Homophonic letter substitution with single signs for names, only sensitive words enciphered.
